findings.description: c61c871 requires the contractor workspace to be beneath the profile home, but the authorized 33god-pm workspace and profile directories are disjoint; the real route fails while the focused test uses a nested fixture.

c61c871 passes a null service tier explicitly for a normal contractor turn, but route resolution treats null as omitted and falls back to shared runner state; sibling-turn service-tier contamination remains possible.

c61c871 puts cleanup_error into the private worker result, but _handle_contractor_turn then discards that field and returns only final_response; Bloodbank on_processing_complete therefore records success and the caller receives no cleanup status. QF-3 is logged locally, not surfaced across the contract.
